5304.title: Browser launcher keychain investigation
5304.rootCauseOneLine: The local launcher omits a mock-keychain switch, verified twice; the reported macOS cookie-key stall could not be exercised on this Linux host.
5304.proposedFix: First reproduce cookie reads and HTTPS navigation on an isolated macOS host, then compare otherwise identical launches with and without the keychain bypass and assess its security implications.
5304.caveats: No macOS host, Keychain service, Chrome executable, or DevBrowser binary was available to this isolated investigation. A diagnostic executable captured real BB launch arguments, not cookie or network behavior. No fix or pull request was attempted.
